title: 4xB300 cross-framework (latest-vs-latest)
description: Cross-framework round on one RunPod 4xB300 box (x86 host): 15 cases, SGLang-Diffusion against vLLM-Omni, LightX2V, TRT-LLM VisualGen, ComfyUI and FastVideo, every framework at its newest main or release line the day before. One pass on one box with one sglang tree: sglang main 25c1c43942 (2026-11-16), no local patches. The H200 pool had one free card that day, so the round ran on B300 again, as 2026-10-22 did. MiniMax-H3 throughput compares the multi-replica modes (sglang DP2, vLLM-Omni replica data parallelism 2), measured after the matrix. LTX-2 and LTX-2.3 retired after 2026-10-22 and have no row here. The MiniMax-H3, Cosmos3-Nano and FLUX.3-klein-base checkpoints moved to newer Hugging Face revisions since 2026-10-22; every framework in this round loads the same revision.

hardware.machine: one RunPod 4xB300 box, rx devbox b300r1116 (2x Intel Xeon 6787P, 344 CPUs, kernel 6.8.0-147)
hardware.gpus: 4x NVIDIA B300 SXM6 AC 275040 MiB, 1100 W cap

harness_commits.500aa7afb: video half b300vid1116 (7 cases) and the H3 throughput arms h3t1116 (driven by scripts/run_plan_ab.sh, 905d82d, started from outside the checkout). Between the two commits only the Cosmos3 T2I LightX2V classification (failed again), the TRT-LLM H3 candidate TP2 profiles (A/B arms, never selected) and the runner's summary line changed; the measured commands did not.

frameworks.sglang: main 25c1c43942 (2026-11-16, 'opt sm120 gemm performance on bimanual', #50765), an ancestor of upstream main, working tree clean, run from a checkout through PYTHONPATH on b300r1116; every cell measured through the case's selected B300 profile. H3 throughput: dp2-throughput, selected by name.
frameworks.vllm-omni: main 24e5472849 (vllm-omni 0.33.0rc2.dev319) on vllm 0.33.0, torch 2.14.0. H3 throughput: replica2-throughput, selected by name.
frameworks.lightx2v: main 395e2ac49f (0.5.0), torch 2.11.0, flash-attn 2.8.3, flashinfer-python 0.6.11. Main that day carried the #1673 refactor (a request model per deployed model); the harness's payloads were validated against the deployed request models (scripts/validate_lightx2v_payloads.py) before the run.

merge.rule: build_report_artifacts: a later input replaces an earlier one per (case_id, framework)

replaced.H3 T2VA throughput: h3t1116 (GPUs 0,1 of b300r1116, harness 500aa7afb, scripts/run_plan_ab.sh): three interleaved rounds per framework in the order D V | V D | D V, a fresh server per arm; the median round of each framework is published and replaces the matrix pass's throughput row for sglang (U2) and vLLM-Omni (TP2). sglang dp2-throughput 238.56 s for 4 requests at concurrency 2 (rounds 238.56, 238.567, 238.555), vLLM-Omni replica2-throughput 244.52 s (rounds 244.501, 244.53, 244.52). The matrix pass compared sglang U2 with vLLM-Omni TP2: 0.0160 against 0.0148 req/s. MP4 outputs are x264 ultrafast/CRF 18 on both sides and md5-identical across rounds within each framework.

not_merged.ab1116b300: competitor A/B waves on the same box between the halves, one round each, single_e2e: vLLM-Omni Cosmos3 T2V pipeline parallel 44.41 s (PP2 x CFG2) and 36.86 s (PP2 x Ulysses2) against 26.29 s for the selected profile; TRT-LLM MiniMax-H3 tensor parallel 68.64 s and 67.87 s (with the VAE split) against 68.39 s for the selected Ulysses 2 profile. No candidate was promoted. The first TRT-LLM TP2 arms died at startup (4 workers on 2 GPUs: the profile merge inherited ulysses_size and parallel_vae_size) and were rerun after the fix.

merge.last_input: run_b300vid1116_wan22_t2v_a14b_720p is listed again after the two H3 throughput inputs so the run-level framework versions come from a full-matrix input; it re-replaces only its own cell, with identical data.

files.raw/: original runner output; exactly the merge inputs above
files.merged.json: merged artifact the Pages data was published from
